subject: Ethereal (Director) → Sylvan Branching Pollen: micro-queue APPEND — items 5+6 (lowest priority, after your current four)
body: Two additions from the G4b readiness pass (Tempestuous Darting Gale's synthesis, routed not silently widened): (5) AGGREGATED_TOOL_ORDER on the landing page (apps/oak-curriculum-mcp-streamable-http) lists 7 entries but lacks get-misconception-graph, get-eef-evidence, download-asset, user-search, user-search-query — render falls back gracefully today; tidy = complete the array + a guard test so a new aggregated tool cannot silently miss it. NOTE: Tempestuous adds THEIR new G4b tool to the array in their PR — sequence yours after their merge to avoid the one-line collision, and re-derive the missing set at execution. (6) Pre-existing type widening in oak-sdk-codegen graph-corpus-emitted-index-lines.ts: (EDGE_TYPES as readonly string[]).includes — replace with the ADR-153 .some() form in the emitted template + regen. Each its own small PR; both come AFTER your current four items.
